Acquire.description:
Asks one permit for `request`, and names where its notices go. With room it grants at once; otherwise the request
waits in FIFO order; with the queue full it is refused and nothing is recorded. The answer, `granted`, `queued` or
`refused`, goes to the target in this commit, so a target that is gone rejects it and nothing is recorded. A
repeated `Acquire` of a holder answers `granted` with the same number, one of a waiting request `queued` with its
place kept; both keep the target of the first. A request ID is forgotten at its release: use a fresh one per
attempt.

messageType.description:
The message type of the notices, whose payload is a [`PermitNotice`]; not empty, at most 200 characters,
without NUL.

Acquire.title: Acquire

Audit.description:
Sends a `check` notice to every request in the books, holders with their grant number and waiting requests
without, each in a turn of its own. A holder whose `granted` notice has not committed yet gets none: its grant
is on its way, and the next audit checks it; so a grant number reaches a holder only through `granted`. It frees
nothing: a holder whose work is confirmed stopped answers with `Release`, a waiting request that gave up with
`Cancel`.
Audit.title: Audit

Cancel.description: Takes a waiting request out of the queue; ignored for a holder, which releases with its grant number instead.
Cancel.title: Cancel

Failed.description:
The notification of a message to a watched actor that ended `failed`: what the failed message was and why it
failed. Its type name is `Failed`. A watcher's message family declares it as `Failed(cicada::Failed)`.

Its schema is part of every watcher's contract; a snapshot test pins it.

actor.description: The actor the failed message was for: the actor of the event, not the target of the watch.

attempts.description: How often the message was claimed: its `attempt`.

oneOf.description:
The handler returned an error or panicked, and no retry is left; or it returned a new state that cannot be
stored.

The node or the store failed around the turn: a read the node needed failed, also one the handler passed on,
or a panic outside the handler.
The handler refused the message for good (a permanent failure).
The turn ran past its maximum duration.
The state or the address of the actor cannot be read by its type.
The effects of the turn were refused, or its commit was rejected or refused.
The message reached the claim limit (ADR 0025).

correlationId.description: The correlation id of the failed message; null when it has none.

from.description: The sender of the failed message; null for a message sent from outside a turn.

messageId.description: The id of the failed message.

messageType.description: The type name of the failed message.

payload.description: The payload of the failed message.

Failed.title: Failed

Notify.description:
Sends `request` what is true when it runs: its `granted` notice, or with `check` a `check` notice; nothing for a
request no longer in the books, and no `check` to a holder not yet told of its grant. Sent by the pool to itself,
with a retry policy.

check.description: A `check` of an audit; false: a grant.

Notify.title: Notify

Release.description:
Frees the permit of `request` when it holds `grant`; ignored otherwise, so a late release of an earlier grant
frees nothing.
Release.title: Release

Resize.description:
Sets the capacity, 0 through 1,000; 0 pauses the pool. A growth grants to the head of the queue; a shrink
revokes nothing, and new grants wait until fewer hold than the capacity.
Resize.title: Resize

Stopped.description:
The notification of a watched actor that went away. Its type name is `Stopped`. A watcher's message family declares
it as `Stopped(cicada::Stopped)`. Only a watch on the actor's own address tells of it.

Its schema is part of every watcher's contract; a snapshot test pins it.

by.description:
The actor whose turn removed it: the actor itself when it stopped, the stopping ancestor when it went with it;
null for a removal from outside a turn.

oneOf.description: It was deleted from outside a turn.
It was removed with its parent (ADR 0019).

Stopped.title: Stopped

grant.description: Its grant number: at least 1, below the pool's `nextGrant`.

messageType.description: The message type of its notices; not empty, at most 200 characters, without NUL.

notified.description: True once a `granted` notice to it committed; while false, a failed grant `Notify` frees the permit.

request.description: The request; not empty, at most 200 characters, without NUL.

WaitingRequest.description: A request waiting for a permit.

messageType.description: The message type of its notices; not empty, at most 200 characters, without NUL.

request.description: The request; not empty, at most 200 characters, without NUL.

state.description:
The state of a [`Permits`] pool: its capacity and queue bound, given at its create, its holders in the order they
were granted, its waiting requests in FIFO order, and the next grant number. Build it with `PermitsState::new`; a
decoded state is checked the same way.

On the wire: `{"capacity":4,"maxWaiting":100,"nextGrant":1,"holders":[],"waiting":[]}`; `nextGrant`, `holders` and
`waiting` may be left out of a create.

capacity.description:
The most holders that are granted at once; 0 through 1000, 0 pauses the pool. After a shrink more may hold
until they release.

holders.description: The holders, in the order they were granted, each request ID once in the books; absent: none.

nextGrant.description: The number of the next grant, at least 1; it only goes up. Absent: 1.

waiting.description: The waiting requests, in FIFO order, at most `maxWaiting`, each request ID once in the books; absent: none.

state.title: PermitsState
